project_type: MQL5 MetaTrader 5 Expert Advisor (GaganEA.mq5) plus a Python (stdlib-only) analysis/automation toolchain. This task ADDS a new pure-Python, stdlib-only, in-sandbox tick backtester so XAUUSD strategies can be developed and ranked WITHOUT MT5. GaganEA.mq5 stays the live artifact and MT5 remains the source of truth for validation.
language: Python 3 stdlib-only for the new backtester. Default interpreter is python3 = 3.9.25; python3.11 and python3.12 are also installed. Target 3.9+ compatibility (avoid 3.10+-only syntax like match/case and PEP 604 X | Y unions in annotations unless from __future__ import annotations is used).
build_system: No build system in the sandbox. In-sandbox verification only: python3 -m py_compile. No pip / no external network (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY) -> STDLIB ONLY (csv, datetime, statistics, json, dataclasses, argparse, unittest, zipfile, gzip). No pandas/numpy.
test_command: From repo root: python3 -m unittest discover -s python_bt/tests -p 'test_*.py' -q  (new suite). Existing suites MUST still pass: tools -> `python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p 'test_*.py' -q` (16 tests); tuner MUST be run from its own dir -> `cd automation/tuner && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q` (38 tests, uses tests/_bootstrap.py for sys.path).
verification_instructions: 1) python3 -m py_compile on every new module. 2) Run the new python_bt unittest suite (all green). 3) Regenerate the CSV FROM THE TRACKED CHUNKS via the new extract helper to prove it works from a fresh checkout: the chunks are data/XAUUSD_202607011100_202609011203_2.zip.001..005 -> cat in order to a joined ZIP -> unzip -> yields INNER zip XAUUSD_202607011100_202609011203.zip -> unzip -> data/XAUUSD_202607011100_202609011203/XAUUSD_202607011100_202609011203.csv (526 MB, 11,861,292 data rows). Use Python stdlib zipfile only. 4) Run the runner CLI on a SMALL SLICE of the real CSV (e.g. one day 2026.07.01, or first few hundred thousand ticks, or --to a near date) to prove loader+engine+strategy+metrics work end to end; report metrics but LABEL them a small-slice smoke test, NOT a validated result. 5) Re-run tools (16) and tuner (38) suites: still green. 6) grep -nP '[^\x00-\x7F]' across all NEW files -> empty (pure ASCII). 7) Confirm GaganEA.mq5 is byte-identical/untouched (git diff --stat shows no change to it).

environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network: NO pip, NO external hosts. STDLIB ONLY. No pandas/numpy. Provide date-range slicing and an M5-bar 'fast mode' aggregated from ticks. Cannot compile GaganEA.mq5 or run MT5 in-sandbox - Python parity vs MT5 is UNVERIFIABLE here and must be documented as such.

Reuse automation/tuner/scoring.py score() for ranking (import it) and keep the backtester's metrics dict key names CONSISTENT with tools/analyze_report.py's summary['metrics'] schema (see reports/samples/sample_report.summary.json) so score() consumes them directly. Do NOT reimplement or duplicate scoring/params. Do NOT commit big data files. Append a Round 5 entry to ITERATION_LOG.md (no invented performance numbers; the smoke-test slice metrics may be reported but must be clearly caveated as an unvalidated small-slice smoke test).
key_patterns: SCORING CONTRACT (automation/tuner/scoring.py): score(metrics) maximizes total_net_profit under a HARD 15% relative-DD ceiling; it reads metrics keys total_net_profit, relative_drawdown_pct, profit_factor, total_trades. So the engine's metrics dict MUST populate at least those exact keys (plus the fuller analyzer schema for comparability). ANALYZER SCHEMA (reports/samples/sample_report.summary.json metrics): total_net_profit, gross_profit, gross_loss, profit_factor, expected_payoff, recovery_factor, sharpe_ratio, absolute_drawdown, maximal_drawdown_money, maximal_drawdown_pct, relative_drawdown_money, relative_drawdown_pct, total_trades, total_deals, win_rate_pct, largest_profit_trade, largest_loss_trade, average_profit_trade, average_loss_trade, max_consecutive_wins_count/_money, max_consecutive_losses_count/_money. CSV FORMAT (verified, tab-separated, CRLF line endings): header '<DATE>\t<TIME>\t<BID>\t<ASK>\t<LAST>\t<VOLUME>\t<FLAGS>'; rows like '2026.07.01\t11:00:00.051\t3975.95\t3976.00\t\t\t6' (LAST and VOLUME often EMPTY; TIME has .mmm millisecond precision; DATE YYYY.MM.DD; TIME HH:MM:SS.mmm). Both BID and ASK present on every tick so spread is real per-tick. Range 2026.07.01 11:00 -> 2026.09.01 12:03. GaganEA STRATEGY (v2.12, to port faithfully, NOT byte-exact): trend = price vs HTF EMA200 (H1) AND price vs CTF EMA200 (M5); Min_EMA_Distance in POINTS gate; ATR(14, M5) regime filter (ATR_Min_Points 150 / ATR_Max_Points 4000, ATR in price -> /point for compare); confluence = EMA pullback-and-resume on M5 (within last Pullback_Lookback=6 bars a bar's low<=emaCTF, and last closed bar close>emaCTF for BUY; mirror for SELL) AND entry RSI(14,M5) <= RSI_Buy_Max 68 for BUY / >= RSI_Sell_Min 32 for SELL; session filter hours [Session_Start_Hour 7, Session_End_Hour 20) with rollover-hour skip; Entry_Cooldown_Bars; Max_Concurrent_Positions cap; account is HEDGE (both directions can be open). EXIT: ATR dynamic SL (ask - ATR_SL_Mult*atr, clamp to min-stop) + hard TP (slDist*ATR_TP_Mult/ATR_SL_Mult, R:R ~1.67); OR legacy fixed StopLoss_Pips when ATR SL/TP off. Tiered partials T1/T2/T3: when profit in POINTS >= tier threshold, close T1_ClosePercent then T2_ClosePercent of remaining, T3 full close. Tier thresholds = ATR_Tx_Mult*atr/point (T1 0.8/T2 1.5/T3 2.2) when Use_ATR_Scaled_Tiers else fixed Tx_Pips. Breakeven after T1; individual trailing by Trail_Step_Pips after T2. Lot sizing: riskAmt = balance*Risk_Percent/100; lots = riskAmt / ((slDist/tickSize)*tickVal), normalized to lot step, capped by Max_LotSize. FILL MODEL: buy at ask, sell at bid; SL/TP filled when the opposing/quoted side crosses; commission per lot; spread from the ticks. TUNER PARAM SPACE (automation/tuner/params.py): 11 params with these exact names Risk_Percent, Min_EMA_Distance, Min_Trade_Distance, StopLoss_Pips, T1_Pips, T2_Pips, T3_Pips, T1_ClosePercent, T2_ClosePercent, Entry_Cooldown_Bars, Max_Concurrent_Positions; on gold *_Pips are POINTS. The Python strategy params should map to the SAME names/roles.
instrument_facts: XAUUSD gold, price ~3975-4367 in-window, 2-decimal quotes -> POINT_SIZE = 0.01 (DETECT from data decimals; make it a config constant flagged for user to confirm vs their broker). Contract size 100 oz -> $1.00 price move = $100 per 1.0 lot; i.e. tick_value at tick_size 0.01 is $1.00 per 0.01 per 1.0 lot. Make CONTRACT_SIZE / TICK_VALUE a documented config constant flagged for confirmation - it drives P&L parity. Account to mirror MT5 tests: deposit 1000 USD, leverage 1:500, Fusion Markets (commission broker). Commission per lot per side is a documented config constant flagged for confirmation. Spread comes directly from ask-bid in each tick.
